title: Randomized Study Comparing Docetaxel Plus Dasatinib to Docetaxel Plus Placebo in Castration-resistant Prostate Cancer

sections.abstract:
The purpose of this study is to determine whether survival can be prolonged in patients with castration-resistant prostate cancer who receive dasatinib with docetaxel and prednisone.

Posted outcomes: Overall Survival: Time From Randomization to Date of Death. timeframe=From randomization to death or date of last contact (maximum reached: 45 months). Placebo=21.2; Dasatinib=21.5. p=0.9009
